item.title: Rallying Cry – October 27, 2026
item.description: A family that’s fostered 500 children was saved from a housefire by a stranger’s lucky wrong turn, while 70 million Amazon acres were conserved thanks to dedicated conservation efforts, and a 'Green Army' is stepping up to fight El Niño flooding.
